newsitem.title: GERMANY: EU 1997 oilseeds crop may rise to 13.14 mln tonnes.
newsitem.headline: EU 1997 oilseeds crop may rise to 13.14 mln tonnes.

text.p: The European Union oilseeds harvest in 1997 may be at the higher end of earlier forecasts at 13.14 million tonnes, according to the latest forecasts from oilseeds lobby Coceral, received here.
The figures, which applied to rapeseed, sunseed and soybeans only, were supported by statistics from German trader Toepfer, the Coceral tables showed.
The 13.14 million would represent a 7.9 percent rise over 1996's 12.17 million and compared with analysts' forecasts in early June of a 12-13 million tonnes crop this year.
Other EU protein crops include cottonseed, linseed and pulses.
